positions.as_written: Take the surgical history first: what was resected, how much, and when.
Count and site the arthroscopy portals, which indicate the compartment and sometimes the number of procedures.
Assess standing alignment, because a deficient compartment collapses over years and the change is the main objective finding.
Assess for an effusion and ask whether it follows activity.
